name: print-social-editorial-brand-equity-carousel-cream-numbered-circles
title: 'editorial' brand-equity carousel slide with four numbered circle callouts on textured cream paper
whatItIs: A textured cream square post with a huge lowercase 'editorial' wordmark and '@2024' date, four numbered circle callouts (1–4) each paired with a short paragraph about brand equity, and a closing summary line at the bottom with a small triple-arrow mark.
whatItMeans: Calm and credible; a textured paper background and restrained navy type make a marketing lesson feel like a printed essay.
techniques: Use a large lowercase wordmark as a simple visual anchor.
Number educational points with outlined circles rather than solid badges.
Add a subtle paper grain texture for warmth.

vocabulary.definition: A fine textured overlay mimicking real paper.
A number marker drawn as a stroke only, not filled.
